intent.problem: Tasks cross domains and need an agent that can adapt its working method.
intent.target_users: People who need a general co-worker for research, writing, analysis and software.

safety.reason: Harness2 reads immutable input and writes task files only in the output workspace. Clarifications and notices use the standard conversation channel.

product.benefit: Gets useful work done and learns evidence-supported working methods across tasks.
product.how_it_works: Harness2 executes, proposes harness changes, probes them, composes a refined harness, and retains adopted harnesses and lessons inside its own context.
product.input: Input folder, output folder and instructions at setup; clarifications and decisions in Chat. Defaults to summarizing Downloads.
product.output: A summary.md file by default, an answer, generated files and an observed Harness2 refinement audit in the output folder.
product.customizable_for: Input and output folders and instructions. Answer clarification questions in Chat.
